edits.text:
Confidential Settlement Agreement and Mutual Release

This Confidential Settlement Agreement and Mutual Release (this “Agreement”) is entered into by and between Plaintiff Harrow (“Plaintiff”) and Defendant Delmar (“Defendant”) (collectively, the “Parties”). The Parties desire to resolve fully and finally all disputes and claims between them on the terms set forth below.
edits.name: title_and_intro

edits.text: RECITALS. The Parties are engaged in a dispute concerning the matters alleged by Plaintiff. The Parties desire to avoid the burden, expense, and uncertainty of further litigation and to resolve all claims and potential claims between them as provided in this Agreement.
edits.name: recitals

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Within ten (10) business days after execution of this Agreement by all Parties, Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the Settlement Amount of $[AMOUNT] by [wire/check] to counsel of record, subject to any agreed tax reporting requirements. Except as expressly stated in this Agreement, each Party shall bear its own attorneys’ fees and costs.
edits.name: payment

edits.text: 2. MUTUAL RELEASE. Effective upon timely receipt of the Settlement Amount, each Party, on behalf of itself and its respective predecessors, successors, assigns, affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, and representatives, releases and forever discharges the other Party and its respective predecessors, successors, assigns, affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, and representatives from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, damages, liabilities, costs, and expenses of every kind, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of or relating to the matters addressed in this Agreement, from the beginning of time through the date of this Agreement.
edits.name: release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The existence, terms, and amount of this Agreement shall be kept strictly confidential and shall not be disclosed to any third party except: (a) to each Party’s attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, insurers, and immediate family members who need to know and are instructed to maintain confidentiality; (b) as required by law, regulation, court order, or subpoena, provided the disclosing Party gives prompt notice to the other Party to the extent legally permitted; or (c) to enforce this Agreement. Nothing in this Section prohibits either Party from disclosing the fact of this Agreement as necessary to obtain tax, legal, or financial advice, provided such recipients are bound to maintain confidentiality.
edits.name: confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement is a compromise of disputed claims and shall not be construed as, or deemed to be, an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any Party. Neither this Agreement nor any discussions or negotiations relating to it may be offered or used as evidence except to enforce its terms.
edits.name: no_admission

edits.text: We included a standard mutual-release framework. If your client wants a narrower release (e.g., limited to known claims only), let us know and we can revise quickly.
